instruction.thesis: GOLD FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG short thesis has largely played out: gold_gc_spot has moved from 4,661 to 4,544 (-2.51%), capturing the 5% target zone, and gold_hl_funding_ann has collapsed from 67.52% to 5.48% (-91.88% relative change), which is the primary signal-family evidence for this trade. The funding normalization is the core thesis completion signal - funding has returned to near-baseline levels, meaning the crowded-long squeeze is complete. Holding further risks mean reversion in gold spot as the funding carry advantage has evaporated. The position is at +2.53% P&L against a 5% target and 2.5% stop, and with funding now at 5.48% (no longer extreme), the thesis is invalidated.

instruction.thesis: BTC PROMOTED_HYPOTHESIS long entered at 79,093 is essentially flat (+0.05%) after 8+ hours. The promoted H-148 put-call exhaustion reversal thesis predicted a bounce from the P/C ratio spike, but BTC spot has failed to make meaningful upside progress - it dropped to 79,017 intraday and has only recovered to 79,133. The 1.5% stop is at ~77,900 and the 4% target is at ~82,257. With BTC HL funding persistently negative (-4 to -5% annualized) indicating short-side crowding rather than bullish positioning, and BTC spot failing to hold above 79,200 despite multiple attempts, the momentum reversal thesis is not materializing within the expected timeframe. The risk/reward has deteriorated given the flat price action and the stop is close enough that holding further adds asymmetric downside risk. Closing to preserve capital for better setups.
